body.heading: Become a kindness agent
paragraphs: Your mission, should you choose it, is to do a tiny good deed in secret. Tidy the shoe corner. Leave a kind note in a lunchbox. Draw a picture and slide it under a door.
When the deed is done, leave one paper star nearby. That star is your secret sign — no name, no asking for thanks.

body.heading: Choose good missions
paragraphs: Good missions make life easier or happier for someone. Missions that make a mess or a fright are not kindness at all.
Ask yourself: will this make someone smile when they find it? If yes, it is a perfect mission.

body.heading: Stay secret
paragraphs: The hardest part is not telling. If someone finds your star and wonders, just smile.
Kindness done in secret is still real kindness. Sometimes it is the sweetest kind of all.

takeaway: Secret kindness missions spread smiles without asking for thanks, and a paper star is the only clue.
safetyNotes: Secret missions must be safe and helpful — tidying, notes, and drawings only. Never hide food or touch other people's private things.
screenFreeExtension: Plan tomorrow's mission at bedtime and fall asleep thinking about the smile it will make.
